hypotheses.claim: FFOne never receives P_FE2CL_REP_PC_NEW_EMAIL because OpenFusion emits it only as the reply to P_CL2FE_REQ_PC_EMAIL_UPDATE_CHECK, which clean cnGUINanocom.Update sends 60 s after start (fNewUserMailTime) and then every 600 s once GameFrame.IsReadyForPlay(), and FFOne had no producer for that request.

A positive count plays Email_Arrived twice: cnMainGame.ReceiveNewMail and cnGUINanocom.SetNewMail each call SoundUtil.Playsound; PlayUISountAt allocates a new AudioSource per call and IsPlayable only caps the global sound count.

SetNewMail arms bNewMail for fEMailAlarmTime = 2 s; RenderMenu draws GUI.Label(mailRect(140,150,30,30), mailTexture, imagewindow2) in the NanoRect group with alpha |cos(2*pi*Time.time)| while !bViewMenu. imagewindow2 is MiddleCenter/ImageAbove with zero padding, so the 19x14 mail_but lands at NanoRect-local (145.5,158). Live WindowRect is set to (7,-4,187,183) in Start, so FFOne's minimap group equals NanoRect.

Panel_EmailList.DoData (guide tab, bComEmail) labels the FFSlotEmpty backdrop for a selected row and the GetEquipIconElement(30, sender NPC) icon into rectGuideIcon(10,10,79,68) with FusionFallInvenSkin label (UpperLeft, ImageLeft, padding 3/0/3/0), i.e. 62x62 at (10,13), and moves FROM/SUBJECT right by 79; the player tab does not.
EmailNotice (529) and EmailNoticeUp (69) are byte-identical to mail_but (419).
hypotheses.rejectedBecause: The identical sha256 in the dump reports was the container hash; texel identity was never measured.

differences.subject: P_CL2FE_REQ_PC_EMAIL_UPDATE_CHECK payload
differences.detail: The clean client sends the empty struct with 0 payload bytes. Pinned OpenFusion and FFOne's request registry use its 1-byte C++ size; OpenFusion also zero-fills a 0-byte body. FFOne sends one zero byte, as for P_CL2FE_REQ_PC_GROUP_LEAVE.

conclusion: FFOne now polls the unread-mail check on the clean schedule, rings Email_Arrived twice and blinks the published mail_but icon for two seconds on a positive count, and draws the guide sender icon with the clean label shift. The Nanocom E-MAIL row notice (EmailNoticeTexture at EMailRect) remains unrendered and is tracked separately.
